dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: #Arakunti heard the songs of Nara {NICKNAME}. Brave, and full of hope.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: Just like Nara Varuna, in the stories.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: #But Nara Varuna never returns to Vanarana. Please come visit, Nara {NICKNAME}.
